newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures recover ground but end weak.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures recover ground but end weak.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended slightly weaker after recovering most of their early losses on Thursday, and dealers said the market could be in for a short-term bounce.
Nikkei 225 March futures finished 55 points lower at 20,555 after hitting an early low of 20,300. December futures were down 40 points to 20,525.
Dealers said players were likely to be cautious ahead of the December futures and options settlement on Friday.

"I'm slightly more bullish now that we've gone down and covered the gap (near 20,290)," said a chartist with a local institution. "If resistance is broken at 20,680, I see it going quite far up to 20,980."
But he said the March Nikkei would face stiff resistance around 21,000, from where it could back off again. "The whole technical outlook still seems very bearish," he said.

Dealers said the market came under pressure initially from the Dow's 70-point overnight drop on a series of unsubstantiated rumours and a news report suggesting Japanese investors might slow down their purchases of U.S. treasuries.

Sentiment was also hurt by a Nikkei Financial Weekly report, which quoted a senior Bank of Japan official as saying the central bank may alter its monetary policy before assessing the possible impact of a planned consumption tax hike in April.
